title: AnalyticsVizField - Data API
description: Represents a Tableau Next viusalization field. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

AdHocCalc.description: An ad-hoc calculation for the visualization field.

DisplayCategory.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DisplayCategory.description: The display category for the visualization field. Possible values are: Continuous—continuous Discrete—discrete

FieldKey.description: The key for the visualization field.

Function.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Function.description: The function for the visualization field. Possible values are: Avg Count CountD DatePartDay DatePartHour DatePartMinute DatePartMonth DatePartQuarter DatePartSecond DatePartWeek DatePartWeekDay DatePartYear DateTruncDay DatePartHour DatePartMinute DateTruncMonth DateTruncQuarter DateTruncWeek DateTruncYear FiscalDatePartMonth FiscalDatePartQuarter FiscalDatePartWeek FiscalDatePartYear FiscalDateTruncMonth FiscalDateTruncQuarter FiscalDateTruncWeek FiscalDateTruncYear Max Mdy Median Min My Stdev Stdevp Sum UserAgg Var Varp

HierarchyName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HierarchyName.description: The hierarchy name for the visualization field.

Label.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Label.description: The label for the visualization field.

PositionName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PositionName.description: The position name for the visualization field.

Positional.description: The positional text for the visualization field.

Role.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Role.description: The role for the visualization field. Possible values are: Dimension Measure

SemanticFieldApiName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SemanticFieldApiName.description: The API for the field in the semantic model.

SemanticObjectApiName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SemanticObjectApiName.description: The API name for object the field belongs to in the semantic model.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: The type for the visualization field. Possible values are: Field MapPosition MeasureNames MeasureValues

UniqueIndex.description: The unique index value for the visualization field. This field is a calculated field.

VisualizationId.description: The ID of the visualization the field belongs to. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, you must have Tableau Next enabled in your org and a Tableau Next permission set.
